# Chen Wang Sax Studio

> Private saxophone lessons in Bothell, WA, taught by award-winning saxophonist and educator Chen Wang (王晨). Students of all ages and skill levels are welcome, from complete beginners to advanced players preparing for auditions and competitions. Lessons are in person; students from across the Pacific Northwest attend.

## About Chen Wang

Chen Wang is a saxophonist, educator, and music arranger based in Bothell, WA. He is a Doctor of Musical Arts (D.M.A.) candidate in Saxophone Performance at the University of Washington, holds a Master of Music in Saxophone Performance (University of Washington) and a Master of Education in Music Education (Capital Normal University), and previously earned a B.M. in Music and a B.S. in Geology, both from Capital Normal University.

He has held principal chair positions in the Seattle Wind Symphony, Patterns Saxophone Ensemble, and the University of Washington Wind Ensemble, and co-founded the CNU Alumni Wind Orchestra. He has taught saxophone performance, chamber music, and music theory at Capital Normal University.

Awards include: 1st place at the Ostrava Wind Music Competition (Czech Republic), Gold Award at the 3rd Beijing International Wind Music Festival, 1st place in the Professional Performer category at the American Protégé Music Competition (with an invitation to perform at Carnegie Hall), and the Top Honor Award at My Music Festival (Germany).

Chen serves as a judge for the WMEA All-State auditions, Washington State Solo & Ensemble (saxophone), and the Seattle World Harmonies International Music Competition (Wind Division).

## Lessons

- Location: in person, Bothell, WA area; open to students from across the Pacific Northwest
- Format: private one-on-one lessons
- New students: one complimentary 30-minute trial lesson
- Regular lessons: 45 minutes, $100 per lesson, billed in prepaid four-lesson cycles, cash only
- Cancellations: at least 24 hours' notice by email required; late cancellations (other than same-day illness) are non-refundable
- Students: all ages and skill levels welcome
